scope: Dual-hand-constrained retake and strict real-flower/contact acceptance for global frames 254-342
summary: A new seed-42 dual-hand retake passes all 39 unchanged named-flower, two-hand, contact, motion, identity, temporal, and semantic gates after exact timeline correction and real-instance restoration.
evidence: The immutable raw Wan result has SHA-256 6b0961f68c634c3a6b8264eb15b70c908b8de0613e510d943feeeeb72ca74a13 and decodes 88 frames at 896x512/30 FPS.
The reproducible retimer applies setpts=1.25*PTS, a one-frame terminal clone, and 24-FPS output; the resulting candidate decodes exactly 89 frames before source-tracked flower restoration.
Two restored candidate flower tracks remain visible for 89/89 frames with mean adjacent IoU 0.8061 and 0.7856; source-candidate histogram cosines are 0.9953 and 0.9812.

A finger-only image-left prompt tracks the articulated support gripper for 89/89 frames with 9.69-pixel maximum centroid step and 0.9118 mean adjacent IoU; the independent image-right gripper tracks 89/89 with 11.62-pixel maximum step and 0.9337 mean adjacent IoU.
The two contact segments are visible throughout; left-to-cream p90/maximum distance is 0.0/14.87 pixels and right-to-cream is 3.0/12.04 pixels under unchanged 8/15-pixel thresholds.
The restored candidate scores motion 0.845566, target identity 0.982070, and temporal consistency 0.798759; strict-object-gate-v1 reports WORKING, ALLOW_FULL_FILM_EXPANSION, and 39/39 gates passed.
lessons: Prompting the visible articulated fingers rather than the lower palm-root/wrist removes the semantic ambiguity that invalidated earlier left-hand tracks.
The generic bouquet object proxy remains unsuitable, but explicit named flowers plus independent hand/contact tracks provide an auditable acceptance route.
Exact raw-Wan retiming and terminal-frame cloning must precede restoration and tracking so every downstream artifact shares the 89-frame source timeline.
limitations: Contact is 2D mask distance in camera pixels, not force, 3D geometry, or tactile sensing.
The terminal 89th frame is an exact clone because Wan emitted 88 real frames.
This acceptance covers only global frames 254-342 and does not promote unverified full-film windows.
next_actions: Freeze this candidate and its flower/hand/contact masks as the third strict anchor.
Apply the same raw-retime, source-instance restoration, finger-level two-hand tracking, and unchanged gate to the next isolated overlap window before stitching.
